title.narrative: Strengthening efforts to promote gender equality among the asylum-seeking and refugee population in Mexico

description.narrative: The project proposed by UNHCR Mexico is a social project focussing on improving the life and conditions for some of the most vulnerable groups among the people forced to flee. The project is focuses on mitigating the risk of gender-based violence for people forced to flee and ensure that all survivors have adequate and timely access to services: For example, through 1,250 dignity kits to women and girls in conditions of greater vulnerability with hygiene items. Furthermore, the project focuses on supporting access to childcare for refugee women to facilitate their socioeconomic integration in Mexico. The project is focused around three areas of Mexico: Tapachula, Tenosique y Guanajuato.

UNHCR Mexico will seek to work on three main axes in the area of gender equality to (1) mitigate the risk of gender-based violence for people forced to flee and (2) ensure that all survivors have adequate and timely access to services, as well as promote the economic inclusion of women refugees and asylum-seekers through (3) support, information and follow-up about how to access public and private services, such as childcare.
